input.eligible_column_order: exact order frozen by v0.74 receipt

standardization.mean: arithmetic mean over exact frozen island universe

pca_rule.input: population-z standardized safe habitat variables only
pca_rule.eigenvalue_order: descending; ties broken by oriented loading float-hex signature
pca_rule.sign_orientation: largest absolute loading positive; ties use lowest variable index
pca_rule.negative_eigenvalue_rule: values in [-1e-12,0) clamp to zero; below -1e-12 STOP
pca_rule.retention: smallest number of PCs reaching at least 80% cumulative explained variance

output.reference_csv: Island plus HAB1 for one-variable mode, or Island plus PC1..PCk for PCA mode; values encoded as Python float hex
output.receipt: input SHA, standardization constants, PCA eigenvalues/loadings/explained fractions and output SHA

success_ceiling.reason: habitat reference alone does not clear intake until the real v0.75 spatial partition is also successfully frozen
